latin: Quia intellectus animalis differt ab intellectu intellectuali ut pars media, non ut pars tantum, ideo intellectuali totalitati magis parificatur.
translation: Because the animate intellect stands apart from the purely intellectual intellect as a middle term rather than as a mere fragment of it, it comes closer to matching the intellectual whole.
